technique_name: Create a plan for how the given organization can perform the task.
description: The marketing agency should develop a marketing strategy that prioritizes environmental responsibility. This can be done through creating campaigns that focus on Raise awareness of environmental issues and solutions; increase the usage and emphasis of renewable energy sources; and/or promote eco-friendly products. They should also take into account the environmental consequences of the production process, and explore ways to minimize their environmental impact while maximizing the effectiveness
example:
Organization: Marketing Agency
Task: Developing a marketing strategy that is friendly to the environment
